# ion

ion applies realistic neon lighting across the whole Obsidian interface so panels and elements carry glow and depth. The recorded description calls the aesthetic experimental and high-contrast, and the theme index lists dark mode only.

![ion screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zamsyt/obsidian-ion/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "ion"
    author: "zamsyt"
    repo:   "zamsyt/obsidian-ion"
    slug:   "ion"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ion"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/zamsyt/obsidian-ion"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zamsyt/obsidian-ion/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply realistic neon lighting across the entire Obsidian interface for immersive glow and depth. Embrace an experimental, high-contrast dark aesthetic that gives panels and UI elements a vivid neon look."
}
```
